status.descriptionEn: MCP server status: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DELETING, FAILED, or CREATE_PROBE_FAILED. CREATE_PROBE_FAILED applies only to an initial CODE_PACKAGE origin probe failure before gateway publication, with no successful publication, completed compensation, and a terminal task. UpdateMcp may correct protocol and restart CREATING. Failures after a successful publication remain FAILED and do not allow protocol changes. Poll asynchronous operations until READY, FAILED, or CREATE_PROBE_FAILED; deleted servers stop being returned.
